factual_basis_before: The Financial Times reported an approximately 13-hour Cost Explorer interruption and linked the triggering change to use of Kiro. Amazon later described the event as a brief interruption of one service in one region caused by a user error and access-control configuration, not autonomous AI action; it reported no customer inquiries and no impact to compute, storage, databases or AI services.
factual_basis_after: The Financial Times reported an approximately 13-hour Cost Explorer interruption and linked the triggering change to use of Kiro. Amazon later described the event as a brief interruption of one service in one region caused by a user error and access-control configuration, not autonomous AI action; it reported no customer inquiries and no impact to compute, storage, databases or AI services.
decisive_reasoning: The Financial Times reports roughly thirteen hours of Cost Explorer interruption, supporting service S3 at medium confidence. Amazon acknowledges limited interruption but disputes duration/characterisation and autonomous AI causation. The band describes the reported occurrence consequence, not a finding that Kiro caused the full outage or that other AWS services failed.
